name: North Higgins Lake State Park Campground
evidence: DNR park + campground maps and Esri satellite: West loops (1-93) sit behind a private residential shore strip, East loop (100-187) behind ~130 m of continuous forest; no RV pad near Higgins Lake. DNR 'set along the north shore' is prose

name: Old Grade Campground
evidence: NAIP + Esri satellite at 44.0602,-85.8494: the small loop's south leg runs ~35-45 m from the ~10 m Little Manistee behind a treeline; one clearing at the bank may be a site or the trail landing, not legible. No FS site map; default down

name: Nichols Lake South Campground
evidence: rec.gov site coords on Esri: nearest pads 65-100 m from Nichols Lake through forest, on a bench 13-24 m above the lake (DEM 261-272 vs 248; 'stairs lead down'). The rec.gov Lakefront tag is on every reservable site incl. interior #20, so it's blanket

name: Northern Sites Campground
evidence: Esri z19 + NAIP at 43.9354,-84.4778: lower loop's west lane follows the Cedar River on open lawn; RVs park east of that lane, ~25-40 m from the bank with the lane between. No pads seen on the river-side strip; operator gives no site map (RoverPass shows nothing on sale)

name: Perch Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on 9 of 20 drive-in RV sites (5,7,8,10-12,15-17). Plotted on NAIP, 11,12,15,16,17 sit 3-16 m from shore; 3DEP puts site 16 ~1 m above the lake. Canopy-blind imagery does not contradict

name: Perch Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri z18 + NAIP at 46.6303,-85.6030: pads in pines ~20-55 m from the lake behind trees, on a bank ~8-12 m above the water (3DEP 221-225 vs 213; DNR stairs down to the lake). That's a bluff, so not on-water; lakeview kept, canopy prevents a downgrade

name: Peterson Bridge Campground
evidence: Esri at 44.2025,-85.7982: RV loop on a terrace ~10 m above the Pine River (3DEP 251 vs 240), 45-145 m back through conifers. rec.gov Riverfront tags are only on tent-only boat-in sites 21-31 (riverbank sites, their RIDB coordinates misplaced)

name: Petes Lake Campground
evidence: Pin was ~450 m W on the access road; re-pinned to the site cluster. rec.gov coords on Esri/NAIP: full-shade sites, nearest (4A/5A/2A) ~20-55 m from Petes Lake through forest, no Proximity-to-Water tags. 'A few sites overlook the lake' is prose; canopy-blind, default down
